system.description: When you roll to find an illusion or invisible target within short range and your roll is less than a 12, treat the roll as a 12. (This means you don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) This ability lasts until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. Action to initiate. Effort: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3. At tier 3: The minimum number rolled for this ability increases to 15.
